description: One country's facts: the official free route, what is hard from abroad, what the money is worth and dated obligations. Use it for a question about one country. Quote each fact with its source and read date, and link officialSite or sources[].url where given, else citation.url.

country.description: A country: English or native name, alias or ISO code, for example NL or Netherlands.

include_offer.description: Optional, default false. Set true to add next_step, our report offer for this country. The offer the person sees comes from check_work_history (one offer for the whole history) or create_order_link.

language.description: Optional. Language of our own sentences, default en: en, ar, da, de, es, fa, fr, hi, id, it, ja, ko, nb, nl, pl, pt, pt-BR, ro, ru, sv, th, tl, tr, zh, vi, uk, bg. Facts stay as stored.

pensionType.description: Optional. state, workplace, provident or personal. Overrides the question.

previousNameCount.description: Optional. How many earlier names (a maiden or married name) the person worked under, from 0 to 5. Send the number only, never the names.

question.description: Optional. The person's question in plain words, used only to tell which kind of pension it is about.

name: country_pension_facts
title: Country pension facts
